summary: Executed authenticated mobile-web UI coverage via local Playwright pytest with ASGI route forwarding (**/api/** -> shared api_client) in same async loop. Covered admin panel + requests/history + directory + rates/slabs + PDF flow, telecaller requests/leads, billing rates/slabs, and customer home/gallery. All 4 authored UI tests passed.

integration_issues.issue: Observed intermittent chunk upload conflict (POST /api/pdf-upload/{id}/chunk?chunk_index=1 -> 409) during browser upload; flow still completed after analysis/process path.

action_items: Review PDF chunk upload robustness on web for duplicate/overlapping chunk requests returning 409.
Keep this new routed-browser test as regression for authenticated synthetic coverage.
critical_code_review_comments: Authenticated test harness now correctly avoids local loopback server and forwards browser /api calls through in-process ASGI transport, preserving Authorization/content-type headers.
Web auth state remains memory-based; tests must navigate in-app (no hard reload) after OTP login to preserve session in UI automation.
seed_data_creation: Created only synthetic in-test records (TEST products/requests/customer lead fields) inside isolated_db fixtures; no production mutations.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Execution used /opt/plugins-venv python because default runtime lacked playwright. Installed backend requirements into /opt/plugins-venv to satisfy shared conftest dependencies. External transports are fixture-backed: SMS + storage are MOCKED; API/business logic is real app code via ASGI forwarding.
rca_of_issue: PDF upload UI attempted an extra chunk index on tiny sample, causing 409 conflict. Reproduction: admin login -> panel products -> PDF import -> select sample -> upload. Despite 409 on one chunk call, job record existed and review/commit completed after process_job invocation. Likely duplicate chunk dispatch/race in frontend uploader for small payload segmentation.
